evidence: Thin Film Deposition. Approximately 500 nm-thick Al2O3 thin films were deposited on p-type Si(100) substrates by PEALD using trimethylaluminum (TMA) as the aluminum precursor and O2 mixed with a small amount of N2 as the oxygen precursor at 473 K with an rf plasma power of 300 W without an external bias. Ar was used as a carrier gas at a pressure of 3.0 Torr.
